proposed_facts.reason: Independently inspected the complete callback and COPY_ATTRS definition. The macro retrieves Fighter user data, casts existing dat_attrs and ft_data->ext_attr storage to the supplied type, and performs structure assignment. It neither allocates storage nor assigns the dat_attrs pointer. The functionality document agrees with this correction.
